question: The average weight of 12 persons increases by 0.5 kg when two of them, weighing 40 kg and 46 kg, are replaced by two new persons. What is the average weight of the two new persons?

solutionHi: कुल भार 12 × 0.5 = 6 kg बढ़ता है। नए दोनों का भार 40 + 46 + 6 = 92 kg, औसत 46 kg।

question: 2 years ago, the average age of a committee of 6 members was 52 years. Since then a member aged 58 years (today) has retired and a new member has joined in his place. The average age of the committee today is the same as it was 2 years ago. How old is the new member?

question: 4 years ago, the average age of a committee of 8 members was 43 years. Since then a member aged 68 years (today) has retired and a new member has joined in his place. The average age of the committee today is the same as it was 4 years ago. How old is the new member?

solutionHi: कुल भार 10 × 1.5 = 15 kg बढ़ता है। नए दोनों का भार 52 + 53 + 15 = 120 kg, औसत 60 kg।

question: In a class, the average mark of the boys is 41, that of the girls is 66, and that of the whole class is 63. What percentage of the class are boys?
